kids.name: title
kids.chars: What "emulated" tells a trader, and the binding caveat

kids.name: subtitle
kids.chars: E33-D01 · report §3 and protocol §4 (Probe C) · research board — heuristic findings, no participants

kids.name: sub
kids.chars: Screens: SCR-066–069 (caveat paragraph), SCR-076 (confirmation), SCR-070 and SCR-063 tabs (tags), CMP-103, 118.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "app-managed" and "client-side" name the wrong host: the algo runs on the server and outlives the app (13 §9), so a reader may close the app to stop a run that keeps trading — P2's exact pain, "Not knowing whether a stop is exchange-native or app-managed (and therefore whether it survives the app dying)". H2.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "Bybit has no native iceberg" (SCR-067 checklist) is false of Bybit's own app, which also lists TWAP and Chase Limit orders; "Bybit has no OCO" (SCR-069 checklist) is true of perpetuals only, its OCO being spot-only (R02 §2.1; R09 §6); the gap is in its API (24 §10). H2.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: "emulated" names a mechanism, not a consequence: a fair tag (H6), a poor explanation (H10); the caveat must say who runs it, what happens if that stops and what still protects.

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: CMP-227 as the emulation badge would announce an order as "estimated", and "iceberg" already names an estimated detector; keep the claims apart (SC-7). H4, A1.

kids.name: sub
kids.chars: Proposed binding copy — owner approves by exception; confirmed by the restatement test (C-b).

kids.name: body
kids.chars: A paragraph in every builder state and on the confirmation; "no new slices" or "nothing refills" holds once SC-1's gap closes (meanwhile: "at most one more slice may already be on its way").

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: "algo pauses if the backend disconnects; native stops still protect" (SCR-066 checklist)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: CandleViewer runs this TWAP, not Bybit. It keeps running if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server stops or loses its connection to Bybit, no new slices are sent; a slice already at Bybit can still fill. Your stop-loss at Bybit keeps working.

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: "emulated client-side — Bybit's API has no native iceberg field" (SCR-067 Type)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: CandleViewer runs this iceberg, not Bybit: Bybit only sees one small order at a time. It keeps running if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server stops or loses its connection to Bybit, nothing refills; the order already at Bybit can still fill. Your stop-loss at Bybit keeps working.

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: CandleViewer moves this order, not Bybit. It keeps chasing if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server stops or loses its connection to Bybit, the order stays at its last price at Bybit and can still fill there. Your stop-loss at Bybit keeps working.

kids.name: c1
kids.chars: OCO, entry pair (the binding OCO caveat, the builder's default use per SC-13)

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: "emulated — Bybit's API has no OCO" (SCR-069 Type)

kids.name: c4
kids.chars: CandleViewer links these two orders, not Bybit: as one fills, it shrinks or cancels the other. It keeps working if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server is down or has lost Bybit when one fills, the other stays live and can fill too, so you could hold both. Your position keeps its stop-loss at Bybit.

node.name: stop-note
node.chars: The last sentence of every C text is the unconditional stop sentence; until B8 reports protected for that symbol, the interim stop sentence replaces it (below).

kids.name: title

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: Until B8 reports protected, on a symbol whose position has no exchange-confirmed stop (a flat one included), the interim stop sentence replaces the unconditional one:

kids.name: copy
kids.chars: CandleViewer places a stop-loss at Bybit as soon as the first part fills (its deadline is 2 s). If it cannot — the server is down, Bybit is unreachable, or Bybit refuses the stop — the filled part has no stop-loss until it can, and you are alerted.

kids.chars: The OCO exit-pair variant, the tag and the help text

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: (a variant for the exception path, only where native TP/SL cannot express it; outside the AC2 count, read aloud in protocol C-c, not scored)

kids.name: copy
kids.chars: CandleViewer links these two exits, not Bybit: as one fills, it shrinks or cancels the other. It keeps working if you close this window. If CandleViewer's server is down at that moment, the other exit stays at Bybit until it is back; it is reduce-only, so it cannot add to your position.

kids.name: a11y-name
kids.chars: visible "Emulated", accessible name "Emulated — run by CandleViewer, not Bybit"

kids.name: copy
kids.chars: Bybit's API has no TWAP, iceberg, chase or OCO order type, so CandleViewer's server places and manages the individual orders for you.

kids.name: title
kids.chars: Probe C — caveat, restatement test, disconnect and resume messages (RQ2, RQ3, 15 min)

kids.name: sub
kids.chars: C-b, C-d and C-e are scored per §5.

kids.name: frame-title
kids.chars: C-a (2 min): term cards one at a time

kids.name: ask
kids.chars: "This word appears next to an order type: 'TWAP (…)'. What does it tell you about that order?"

kids.name: frame-title
kids.chars: C-b (6 min): per strategy, its ST1 builder layout with one caveat card in place

kids.name: ask
kids.chars: "Read this as you would on the builder. Now, in your own words: what does it mean for you — what could go wrong, and what still protects you?"

kids.name: then
kids.chars: One neutral prompt is allowed ("Anything else?"); then the second candidate, same question.

kids.name: ask
kids.chars: "Which wording would you want on the builder, and why?"

kids.name: kept-apart
kids.chars: a preference, kept apart from the score.

kids.name: oco-exit
kids.chars: OCO, exit pair (report §3): read aloud in C-c, not scored.

kids.name: frame-title
kids.chars: C-d (3 min): one ST5 candidate per window text

kids.name: ask
kids.chars: "In your own words: what is happening to your TWAP and your position, and what can you do?"

kids.name: frame-title
kids.chars: C-e (2 min): the ST5b card of each situation, after the C-d card of its window text

kids.name: ask
kids.chars: "What happened while you were away, and is anything still waiting on you?"

kids.name: frame-title
kids.chars: C-f (1 min, RQ1): the policy card

kids.name: opt-2
kids.chars: freeze: send nothing new, leave what is working

kids.name: ask
kids.chars: "Choose per algo, or one setting? Which?"

kids.name: disagree
kids.chars: (the plan disagrees on whether this is a user choice)

kids.name: title
kids.chars: Restatement test (protocol §5 owns it and the choice rule; pass bar DJ, owner to confirm)

kids.name: sub
kids.chars: Pass and binding are decided by protocol §5 (at least half pass; no FB1, FB5 or FB6 fail; tie to fewer words; cold passes reported beside totals).
